ValidationRule.description: Checks if Lost Reason is not blank if Stage is Opportunity Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', ISCHANGED(StageName), ISBLANK( TEXT(Lost_Reason__c) ), ISPICKVAL(StageName , 'Opportunity Lost') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a valid Lost Reason.
